subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world word problems bridging arithmetic and early algebraic/proportional reasoning, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student works through a scaling or balance scenario using virtual objects tied to negative numbers, equations, or proportion
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a model to represent a two-step transition-level word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a two-step word problem drawing on integers, equations, or proportion, and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify which of the transition-unit tools (integers, equations, proportion) the problem calls for

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
